📘 **Lesson 1**

This introductory Java course, Ch:1 of Lesson A, aims to provide you with an understanding of what Java is and how to set up your development environment for coding in the language. You will learn about Java's core characteristics—its ability to run on any device through JVM bytecode (platform independence), its object-oriented nature using classes and inheritance, strong typing requiring explicit data type declarations, automatic memory management with garbage collection, and a comprehensive standard library known as Java API for various functionalities. You will also see how these concepts come together in practical code examples to reinforce your understanding of the fundamentals of programming in Java.

---
Say **'complete'** to mark this lesson done and continue.
Say **'exit course'** to leave the course.
Say **'progress'** to see your course progress.
